units.source_text: 这回可以不用害怕屡屡的挫折，不用害怕金阁来阻挡女人和我之间的挫折了。

en.t: This time I no longer had to fear repeated setbacks, nor did I have to fear the Golden Pavilion standing in the way of the setback between the woman and me.

units.source_text: 因为我不做任何幻想，我也不想让女人来参与我的人生。

en.t: For I entertained no fantasies at all, and I did not want a woman to take part in my life either.

units.source_text: 我确定我的生在彼方，我到达彼方之前的行动，只不过是履行凄惨的手续罢了。

en.t: I was certain that my life lay beyond, and that all my actions before reaching that place were nothing more than carrying out a wretched procedure.
